summary: acer nitro 16 gaming laptop experiencing thermal throttling and BSOD errors due to outdated drivers and BIOS, requiring update to prevent performance issues.
detected_fault: Outdated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 drivers and Intel Core i7-12700H BIOS causing thermal throttling and BSOD errors.
suggested_solution: Update NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 drivers to version 530.12.02 or later and ensure Intel Core i7-12700H BIOS is at version F30 or later.
